meta.title: Russia in Winter · CEIBS classmates · January 2027
meta.description: A private winter journey for CEIBS classmates. January 24–31, 2027: Moscow, Teriberka, and St. Petersburg. Pre-register.

hero.eyebrow: A private journey for CEIBS classmates
hero.imageAlt: Red Square and Saint Basil’s Cathedral under snow, Moscow

tracks.title: Come for one reason. Stay for the others.
tracks.intro: Mix the tracks. Most people do.

items.title: Business
items.text: Tell us your business interest, and we will arrange private meetings and company visits for you. Moscow and St. Petersburg, with optional extra days February 1–3.

items.title: Education
items.text: SKOLKOVO, Russia’s leading business school, plus a lecture on doing business in Russia and meetings with top tech companies like Yandex and Sber.

items.title: Culture
items.text: The Kremlin under snow, the Hermitage, the palaces of St. Petersburg, and a Moscow night out.

items.title: Unique
items.text: One day at the edge of the Arctic: Teriberka, sled rides, the Barents Sea, and sea urchins and scallops eaten minutes after a diver brings them up.

tracks.campusAlt: The disk-shaped campus of the Moscow School of Management SKOLKOVO

why.title: Why Russia, why winter
why.imageAlt: Snowy Arctic coast at Teriberka, on the Barents Sea

points.title: Winter, unfiltered
points.text: Snow-covered cities, holiday lights, warm restaurants, and the theatre season. This is Russia when it feels most like itself.

points.title: Warmer than the rumour
points.text: January sits around −6 °C in Moscow, −5 °C in St. Petersburg, and −8 to −10 °C in Murmansk and Teriberka. The Barents Sea stays open thanks to the Gulf Stream. We send a warm-clothing checklist before you fly.

points.title: Lights, and daylight
points.text: It is northern-lights season. The polar night is already over, so the Arctic still has daylight.

points.title: Three Russias, one week
points.text: The business capital, the Arctic, and the imperial capital.

why.visa: Visa-free entry for Chinese citizens, valid through 31 December 2027. Other nationalities: the organizers help with an e-visa.
